topic: The Fundamental Bridge: The Relationship Between Integrals and Derivatives

sections.title: Intuitive Hook: The Speedometer and the GPS
lecture_lines: Speedometer shows instantaneous speed: the derivative.
GPS history tracks distance: the integral.
Two faces of motion, linked by time.

sections.title: The Geometric Connection
lecture_lines: Area under curves defines the integral.
Small rectangles sum to the total area.

sections.title: The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus (Part I)
lecture_lines: Accumulating rate returns the original function.
Volume growth is the rate of flow.
The area function's rate is the curve.
Fundamental Theorem links accumulation and change.
animations: Show integral as accumulating area at 'C2' (#00FFFF).
Show derivative of area is velocity at 'D2' (#FFCC00).

sections.title: The Inverse Operation: Differentiation and Integration
lecture_lines: Differentiation and integration are inverse operations.
Balloon volume tracks its expansion rate.
animations: Show function and derivative with at 'B2' (#FFFFFF).

sections.title: Summary and Synthesis
lecture_lines: The theorem bridges geometry and algebra.
Complex shapes yield to antiderivative formulas.
Calculus connects slopes to accumulated change.
